Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urinalysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrite positivity, and hematuria, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of glucose in urine may indicate hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy; further evaluation of glycemic status is advised.
